validation.future: The measurement time cannot be in the future.
validation.too_old: The measurement time cannot be more than two years ago.
validation.systolic_gt_diastolic: The systolic number must be higher than the diastolic.
validation.glucose_range_mg_dl: Blood sugar must be between 20 and 600 mg/dL.
validation.glucose_range_mmol_l: Blood sugar must be between 1.1 and 33.3 mmol/L.
validation.slot_mismatch: This time slot is not valid for this measurement.
validation.duplicate_slot: Each time slot can appear only once in the plan.
validation.range_too_long: The date range can be at most 366 days.
validation.to_before_from: The end date must be after the start date.

reminder.title: Time to measure your :what
reminder.body: Today's :slot plan: measure and log your :what.

bp_crisis.title: Your blood pressure is in the crisis range
bp_crisis.what_we_saw: You logged {value}; a reading above 180/120 counts as an emergency.
bp_crisis.advice: Sit quietly for 5 minutes and measure again. If it is still above 180/120, or you have a severe headache, chest pain, shortness of breath, blurred vision, weakness or numbness on one side or trouble speaking, do not wait.
bp_crisis.contact: Ritme does not give a medical diagnosis; in an emergency call 115 now.

glucose_low.title: Your blood sugar is very low
glucose_low.what_we_saw: You logged {value}; below 54 mg/dL (3.0 mmol/L) counts as severe low blood sugar.
glucose_low.advice: Take 15 g of fast-acting sugar now (for example half a glass of juice or 3 to 4 sugar cubes) and measure again after 15 minutes. If you feel confused or drowsy, cannot eat or it does not go up, ask someone near you for help.
glucose_low.contact: Ritme does not give a medical diagnosis; in an emergency call 115 now.
